reason: Although framed as a move/refactor, this PR touches many central planner integration points for `PhysicalIndexHashJoin`: optimizer/task search, cost model v1/v2, plan cache clone/rebuild, hints/stringer/flat plan, and executor builder. Changes around a physical join operator across these paths can hide high-severity regressions in plan selection, cache correctness, or execution wiring, so it is important and risky enough for a focused deep review.
